text:
Nadia: thought experiment: replace all-or-nothing fallback with a small per-tenant preemption credit pool + prioritized admission. idea: credits allow short bursts into fallback without immediate global drain.

Ethan: how do credits get funded? if tenants underuse reservation they should earn credits, right?

Nadia: yes. credits accrue when measured usage < reservation for a sliding window. accrual_rate = k * (reservation - avg_usage). credits decay slowly.

Raj: need prioritization tier and fairness. propose split credit buckets: guaranteed, elastic, emergency. guaranteed never used for spill; elastic used normally; emergency used only for p99 routes or operator override.

Nadia: agree. metrics to add: credit_balance_gauge, elastic_usage_rate, emergency_consumed_count, credit_decay_rate. Also track migrations_triggered_by_credit.

Ethan: operator UX: a throttle slider per-shard and a dry-run mode that shows projected credit states for a replayed spike. plus emergency_drain command that consumes emergency buckets with audit.

Raj: config sketch:
```yaml
preempt_credits:
  window: 10s
  decay_half_life: 1h
  per_tier:
    enterprise:
      accrual_scale: 1.5
      emergency_cap: 8
    standard:
      accrual_scale: 0.6
      emergency_cap: 2
  admission:
    max_migrations_per_window: 10
    jitter: 0.5s
```

Nadia: one tricky tradeoff: credits let noisy tenants spike into fallback which can raise total GPU-hours. include cost_safety knob: if projected cost delta > X% disable elastic consumption.

Ethan: testing plan: 1) unit tests for accrual/decay math; 2) synthetic run: 100 tenants, 20% spike, verify migrations remain under threshold and p99 for gold routes unaffected; 3) small-shard canary for 48h.

preflight-bot: feature-flag rollout scheduled: "preempt_credit_v1" on 3309991400 for shard-3.

ops-bot: alert idea: "credit_exhaustion_surge" if percent_tenants_with_zero_credits > 40% for 5m (P2).

Raj: fairness: include a rolling fairness score and if a tenant is repeatedly denied, escalate to operator flow. also reseed jitter per-window to avoid unlucky repeats.

Nadia: will draft RFC with equations, cost sweep, and PoC operator patch. tagging @Ethan and @Raj. aiming for PoC next week.

Ethan: please include an observability dashboard mockup and example logs for audit events.

Nadia: will do. closing thread to convert notes into RFC.
